extracted_concepts.name: Ratio
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Understand the concept of a ratio and use ratio language.

extracted_concepts.name: Unit Rate
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A unit rate is associated with a ratio.

extracted_concepts.name: Equivalent Ratios
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Make tables of equivalent ratios and find missing values.

extracted_concepts.name: Rational Number
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Ordering and absolute value of rational numbers.

extracted_concepts.name: Number Line
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Understand positive and negative numbers on a number line.

extracted_concepts.name: Absolute Value
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Understand ordering and absolute value of rational numbers.

extracted_concepts.name: Algebraic Expression
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Write, read, and evaluate expressions in which letters stand for numbers.

extracted_concepts.name: Equivalent Expressions
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Identify when two expressions are equivalent.

extracted_concepts.name: Equation
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Understand solving an equation as a process of reasoning.

extracted_concepts.name: Inequality
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Write an inequality of the form x > c or x < c to represent a constraint.

extracted_concepts.name: Area
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Find the area of triangles, quadrilaterals, and polygons.

extracted_concepts.name: Volume
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Find the volume of a right rectangular prism with fractional edge lengths.

extracted_concepts.name: Coordinate Plane
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Draw polygons in the coordinate plane given coordinates for the vertices.

extracted_concepts.name: Measures of Center
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Quantitative measures of center: median and mean.

extracted_concepts.name: Data Displays
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Display numerical data on a number line, dot plot, histogram, and box plot.

extracted_concepts.name: Proportional Relationship
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Decide whether two quantities are in a proportional relationship.

extracted_concepts.name: Constant of Proportionality
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Identify the constant of proportionality from tables, equations, and graphs.

extracted_concepts.name: Linear Expression
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Add, subtract, factor, and expand linear expressions with rational coefficients.

extracted_concepts.name: Multistep Linear Equations
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Solve multistep linear equations and inequalities with rational number coefficients.

extracted_concepts.name: Circle Area and Circumference
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Know the formulas for area and circumference of a circle and use them.

extracted_concepts.name: Irrational Numbers
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Numbers that are not rational are called irrational.

extracted_concepts.name: Integer Exponents
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Know and apply the properties of integer exponents.

extracted_concepts.name: Square Root
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Use square root symbols to represent solutions.

extracted_concepts.name: Cube Root
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Use cube root symbols to represent solutions.

extracted_concepts.name: Slope
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Interpret the unit rate as the slope.

extracted_concepts.name: Similar Triangles
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Use similar triangles to explain why the slope m is the same.

extracted_concepts.name: Function
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A function assigns to each input exactly one output.

extracted_concepts.name: Linear Function
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The equation y = mx + b defines a linear function.

extracted_concepts.name: Pythagorean Theorem
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Understand and use the Pythagorean Theorem.

extracted_concepts.name: Transformations
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Verify properties of rotations, reflections, and translations.

extracted_concepts.name: Scatter Plot
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Construct and interpret scatter plots for bivariate measurement data.

extracted_concepts.name: Linear Model
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Use the equation of a linear model to solve problems.
